jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within KIRA's AI Finance App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

jobs.title: Product Owner / Manager – DEXIOS SaaS-Plattform (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
___________________________________________________________________________ DEXIOS ist unsere Cloud-Plattform für Zutrittskontrolle, Zutrittsmanagement und Zeiterfassung. Die Software ist live, sie ist noch jung, und sie steht jetzt an dem Punkt, an dem aus einem funktionierenden Produkt eine skalierbare SaaS-Lösung wird.
Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für diesen Weg: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird, in welcher Reihenfolge und warum. Du arbeitest nah an der Entwicklung, am Backlog in GitHub und an Architekturdiskussionen, und du verantwortest die Roadmap gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, Marketing, Projektgruppe und Support.
In dieser Rolle hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Wenn du die nächsten Jahre lieber ein Produkt von innen prägen willst als ein fertiges zu verwalten - lies weiter!

 Deine Aufgaben PRODUKT – Roadmap und Priorisierung 
 Du verantwortest die DEXIOS-Roadmap und entscheidest laufend, welche Themen jetzt zählen und welche warten
 Du priorisierst gegen Nutzen, Aufwand und Marktchance und kannst deine Entscheidungen gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Kunden vertreten
 Du schneidest Anforderungen so, dass sie umsetzbar sind: User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien, sinnvolle Releasegrößen
 Du pflegst das Backlog in GitHub und arbeitest im Sprint-Rhythmus direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam
 TECHNIK – Architektur und Systemlogik 
 Du verstehst, wie DEXIOS funktioniert: Mandantenfähigkeit, Rollen- und Rechtemodelle, Berechtigungslogiken, IAM-Anbindung über OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, Konnektoren zu Entra ID, SAP und HR-Systemen
 Du diskutierst mit Entwicklung und SW- Architektur auf Augenhöhe über Machbarkeit, Abhängigkeiten und technische Schulden und hast Spaß daran den Prozess proaktiv zu moderieren, um eine Lösung zu finden
 Code schreiben gehört nicht dazu - aber die Logik hinter dem System interessiert dich, und du kennst sie gut genug, so dass deine Priorisierung trägt
 UX – wie Menschen mit DEXIOS (und zukünftig mit KI) arbeiten 
 Du hast eine Haltung dazu, wie sich Frontends durch KI verändern: Was bleibt Klickpfad, was wird Dialog, was läuft automatisch im Hintergrund?
 Du trägst zur positiven User Experience bei: Wie kommen Sicherheitsverantwortliche, HR-Mitarbeitende oder der Werkschutz mit dem System zurecht, heute und in drei Jahren?
 Die Designgrundlagen von DEXIOS stehen. Du arbeitest damit, entwickelst sie weiter und machst die Vorgaben für User Flows bis hin zu Bedienlogiken
 KI – in der Rolle und im Produkt 
 Du nutzt KI in deiner täglichen Arbeit: Prototypen, User Stories, Analysen, Backlog-Aufbereitung, Kundenfeedback verdichten
 Du baust Prototypen selbst, statt auf Kapazität zu warten. Ein klickbarer Prototyp in zwei Stunden bringt uns weiter als ein theoretisches Konzept in zwei Wochen
 Du bringst deine Perspektive ein, wo KI im Produkt echten Nutzen schafft und wo sie nur Aufsatz wäre
 TEAM – Schnittstellen 
 Du gehst proaktiv auf Kollegen zu, schaffst regelmäßigen Dialog und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen für alle Stakeholder nachvollziehbar sind
 Du holst Feedback von Kunden sowie aus Support-Anfragen und übersetzt diese in Produktentscheidungen
 Du bist bei Kundenterminen dabei, wenn es hilft, und regelmäßig vor Ort in München, weil gute Entscheidungen meist im Gespräch entstehen
 PROFIL – Dein Kompetenzset  
 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder technischer Produktmanager (m/w/d) für ein Softwareprodukt, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit echtem Ownership – du hast das Software- oder SaaS-Produkt verantwortet und durch relevante Reifephasen geführt.
 Cloud- und SaaS-Architekturen, APIs und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut: Du liest eine Schnittstellenbeschreibung, ohne dass jemand sie dir erklärt
 KI ist Teil deiner Arbeitsweise, nicht ein Punkt auf deiner Skill-Liste. Du kannst konkret erzählen, wofür du sie zuletzt eingesetzt hast, und auch, wann sie dich falsch beraten hat
 Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und hast ein Bewusstsein für Informationssicherheit (ISO 27001)
 Was diese Rolle nicht ist 
 Kein Ticket-Schreiben nach fremder Vorgabe. Die Roadmap kommt von dir
 Keine reine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien. Du arbeitest im Sprint mit
 Kein Scrum-Master-Job. Prozesspflege ist nicht der Kern
 Kein fertiges Produkt mit fertigen Prozessen. Vieles bauen wir gerade erst auf, das ist Freiheit und Arbeit zugleich
 

 Das bieten wir Produktverantwortung mit Mandat. Kurze Wege, direkte Berichtslinie an die Leitung der Business Unit, Entscheidungen ohne Gremienmarathon
 Eines der spannendsten Themen im Markt: Zutrittsmanagement wandert in die Cloud, und PCS gestaltet diesen Wandel mit einem eigenen Produkt statt mit Zukäufen
 KI-Werkzeuge, die du wirklich nutzen darfst. Lizenzen, Zeit zum Ausprobieren und ein Umfeld, das KI-gestütztes Arbeiten erwartet statt duldet
 Ein Team, das für Zusammenhalt und Wertschätzung steht, mit flachen Strukturen und Raum für eigene Ideen

Location: Remote, United Kingdom only.

Who We Are

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.

We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Senior Product Manager, you will take ownership of how data is processed at Focal, and shape what that path becomes: from the imports that bring a retailer's planograms, inventory and store metadata into our platform, through the pipelines that turn them into signal, to the metrics and reports their head office acts on. You will work with data engineering, data scientists, analytics, customer success and the retailers themselves. What you build are data products, and the measure of one is what a retailer does differently because of it.

This is a hands-on role. You will set direction and priorities as we roll out to hundreds of new stores, but you are also expected to know the systems well enough to be a partner in an engineering design conversation, pull your own numbers when something looks wrong, and hold a strong position in the discussions with customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • You are a peer to the engineers you work with, someone who understands the systems well enough to know what is expensive and why and when to push back
  • You are drawn to the seams between teams, where ownership is shared and the hardest problems live
  • You write your own queries and interrogate the answers before anyone else has to, and you can name the business number a data product of yours moved
  • You can change your mind in a technical argument, and you can point to the time you did
  • You have strong judgment about what not to build, and you have killed your own work when it stopped earning its place
  • You use AI as part of how you actually work, and you have built things with it that other people went on to use, not demos you gave once
  • You communicate complicated things crisply to people who do not share your context, including customers hearing an answer they did not want
  • You build things that outlast you, whether runbooks, tooling or documented decisions, because you would rather remove yourself as a dependency than be indispensable

What You Will Do

  • Own product direction for the full data path, from how a retailer's data arrives to what our reports say, and set the priorities where the two ends pull against each other
  • Own how customer data gets into Focal: imports, planograms, store metadata, cut-off configuration, and the chain-specific flows each retailer needs
  • Own what comes out and whether anyone acts on it: the metrics, the reporting APIs, the insight-generating agents, and the customer-facing dashboards a head office runs its week on
  • Run discovery with retailers and store colleagues, and turn what you learn into a product
  • Ship, then find out whether anyone used it, and act on the answer
  • Automate your own work with AI and share what you build with the rest of the product team

  • Enough technical depth to reason about APIs, data pipelines and system boundaries, and to be an equal partner in an engineering discussion

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.
 
 Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: 
 
 Programmatic AdTech Domain Expertise: 3–4 years of Product Management experience (with at least 3 years directly in Programmatic, Ad Exchange, SSP, or DSP environments) to lead our DSP-facing ad exchange capabilities across their full lifecycle. You thrive when dissecting OpenRTB specs, auction mechanics, and mobile formats (video, playable, native, display) to turn programmatic complexities into clear product roadmaps.

 Technical Infrastructure & API Fluency: Hands-on comfort working alongside senior engineers to parse system architecture, API designs, JSON data payloads, and latency tracking. You will bridge technical execution with business strategy across a platform running 20+ Go microservices on Kubernetes and Kafka, orchestrating 1,500 bid requests per second.

 Auction Mechanics & Traffic Shaping: Deep analytical capability to optimize win rates, timeout rates, bid density, and Supply Path Optimization (SPO). You will design smart throttling and routing logic that reduces infrastructure QPS costs while maximizing revenue across 120M processed auctions daily.

 Cross-Functional Partner Integration: Direct technical collaboration with the Demand Partnerships team and external partners to lead DSP onboardings and maintain OpenRTB compliance. You act as the translation layer between client feedback, external demand needs, and detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs).

 Data-Driven Metric Ownership: Relentless focus on defining and monitoring core performance indicators including fill rate, bid rate, CPM, and eCPM. You will partner with data teams to analyze complex data sets, troubleshoot technical issues, and measure feature performance alongside ML models making 50 billion daily predictions.

 Agile Product Delivery: Proven track record of owning end-to-end execution, experimentation, and scaling in an Agile environment. You manage multi-stakeholder dependencies cleanly and ship high-throughput features iteratively without sacrificing low-latency requirements.

 
 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. 
 
 What’s in It for You? 
 At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.
 Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

 Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

 Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

 Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

 Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

 
 Our mission is to create an inspiring work environment for amazing people to achieve extraordinary things. Be part of it !
 Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary, and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application!
 We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt 

 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

 Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

 Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

 What You'll Be Doing 

 You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

 Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

 
 Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

 Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

 Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

 Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

 
 What You'll Need to Thrive 

 Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

 
 Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

 You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

 You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

 You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

 You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

 You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

 You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

 You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

 
 Next steps

 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

 
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, KYB - MoonPay Enterprise
jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. 

 This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 

 MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. 

 AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. 

 You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. 

 The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 , made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. 
 

 About MoonPay Enterprise

 MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes.

 KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome.

 What You'll Own

 KYB product strategy & roadmap

 
 
 Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners.

 
 Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation.

 
 MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order.

 
 Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation.

 
 Onboarding funnel & conversion

 
 
 The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step.

 
 Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both.

 
 Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on.

 
 KYB API & partner experience

 
 
 The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once).

 
 Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it.

 
 Compliance as product

 
 
 Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix.

 
 EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product.

 
 Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Anduril is fielding the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles, delivering an ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth platform alongside a manufacturing architecture that scales from large to extra-large vehicle sizes. The Dive-XL programme is designed, built and tested in Australia and is executing against live contracts. The XL Vehicle System team owns the vehicle end to end – systems, software, mechanical, electrical, and integration and test.

You will own programme execution across the XL vehicle system as it moves from development into production, reporting to the Director of Platforms. jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d) - Digitale Informations- und Unterstützungsplattform für rückkehrinteressierte Syrer:innen
jobs.description:
Eine Rolle mit Impact: Seit vielen Jahren begleitet die Social Impact gGmbH rückkehrinteressierte Geflüchtete und Migrant:innen bei der Vorbereitung ihrer Rückkehr und unterstützt sie dabei, sich im Herkunftsland nachhaltig zu reintegrieren und berufliche Perspektiven zu entwickeln.

Mit einer digitalen Informations- und Unterstützungsplattform für rückkehrinteressierte Syrer:innen erweitern wir diesen Ansatz. Sie bündelt aktuelle und verlässliche Informationen, ordnet sie ein und schafft eine fundierte Grundlage für ihre Rückkehrentscheidung und persönliche sowie berufliche Zukunftsplanung.

Als Product Owner (m/w/d) gestaltest du den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung der Plattform maßgeblich mit und sorgst dafür, dass Inhalte, Nutzerführung und technische Umsetzung sinnvoll zusammenspielen.

Die Stelle ist zunächst bis zum 31.12.2027 befristet und ist in Teilzeit (20–32 Std./Woche) zu besetzen. Idealerweise arbeitest du an unserem Standort in Berlin. Grundsätzlich ist die Tätigkeit auch an unseren Standorten in Stuttgart, Leipzig, Köln, Hamburg oder München möglich. Die Gehaltsangaben beziehen sich auf eine Vollzeitstelle und richten sich nach Erfahrung und Qualifikationen. 

 Aufgaben und Verantwortung: Du verantwortest die Entwicklung der digitalen Informations- und Unterstützungsplattform mit Inoloft von der Konzeption über den Aufbau bis zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung. 
 Du strukturierst Inhalte und Informationsbereiche und definierst und priorisierst funktionale Anforderungen. 
 Du entwickelst eine intuitive und zielgruppengerechte Nutzerführung und optimierst diese kontinuierlich. 
 Du koordinierst die Schnittstellen zwischen Redaktion, Grafikdesign, Kommunikation und technischer Umsetzung. 
 Du behältst die Anforderungen und Bedarfe der Zielgruppe im Blick und leitest daraus Weiterentwicklungen der Plattform ab. 
 Du stellst die laufende Qualitätssicherung der Plattform sicher. 
 

 Profil und Kompetenzen: Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich Produktmanagement, Digital-/Medienmanagement, Sozialwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet. 
 Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Steuerung digitaler Produkte und Plattformen. 
 Kenntnisse in nutzerzentrierter Produktentwicklung und ein gutes Verständnis für digitale Nutzerführung. 
 Erfahrung im Umgang mit Content-Management-Systemen. 
 Eine strukturierte, analytische und gleichzeitig nutzerorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Kenntnisse in Inoloft sind von Vorteil. 
 Freude an der Zusammenarbeit und an der Koordination von Schnittstellen. 
 

 Unser Angebot: Gesellschaftliche Wirkung:  Du gestaltest eine digitale Plattform mit, die rückkehrinteressierten Syrer Zugang zu verlässlichen Informationen und damit eine bessere Grundlage für ihre Zukunftsplanung bietet. 
 Gestaltungsspielraum: Du begleitest den Aufbau eines neuen digitalen Angebots von Beginn an und kannst Produkt, Struktur und Nutzerführung aktiv mitgestalten. 
 Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe:  Dich erwartet ein engagiertes, interdisziplinäres Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, gegenseitiger Unterstützung und einer wertschätzenden Arbeitskultur. 
 Flexibles Arbeiten: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten ermöglichen dir eine gute Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben. 
 

 Der Weg zu uns: Du möchtest deine Erfahrung in der digitalen Produktentwicklung einsetzen und eine Plattform mitgestalten, die Menschen einen konkreten Mehrwert bietet?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben und relevanten Zeugnissen. Bitte gib dabei auch deine Gehaltsvorstellung und deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin an.
Die Auswahlgespräche finden fortlaufend statt – bewirb dich gerne frühzeitig.

 Make the hard calls where UX and backend decisions conflict, holding coherence across the full product surface and owning the outcome when trade-offs are required

 Proven experience as a product manager in a regulated fintech or financial services environment, with direct ownership of KYC, KYB, or identity verification products across multiple markets

 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 and 10 paid days of educational leave which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

 🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

 
 💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities

 
 🍽 Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform

 
 🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station

 
 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

 
 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

jobs.title: Product Manager - AI Investing
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Investing.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
 
 What You'll Own 
 Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

 Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

 Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

 Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

 Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

 Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

 Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

  
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

 Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

 Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

 Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

 Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

 High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

  
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

 Can make decisions with incomplete information.

 Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

 Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

 Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

  
 This Role Is Not For 
 People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

 PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

 Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

 People who launch features and then stop caring.

 PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

  
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany. 
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
About Cartesia 
 Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.
 We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.
 We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.
 
 The Role 
 We're looking for a Product and Research Operations Manager to run the operational backbone of Cartesia's Voice function - supporting voice production for customers, talent sourcing and logistics, and voice delivery for Go-To-Market and Customer Success.  Part of your time will go toward cross-functional ad-hoc operations, including supporting growth initiatives.

 Sourcing & Talent logistics - Support voice sourcing alongside the Voice Library Lead. Build the systems to source, vet, and create voices for the voice library with voice acting talent as well as vendors.

 Customer Voice Delivery & Enablement - Own customer-facing voice engagements end to end, driving customers to be successful with our models. Drive voice-related GTM enablement.

 Ad-hoc Strategy and Growth Projects - Support ad-hoc strategy & operations work, including helping run events and marketing initiatives for Cartesia in London. Support Cartesia’s growth in international markets on a project by project basis.

 3 - 6 years as an operator at a high-growth tech startup or in strategy consulting (MBB or similar)

 Customer-facing chops, with the ability to drive conversations with executives

 Semi-technical - comfortable using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, etc to build lightweight systems, and understands core concepts of system design

 Genuine interest in operating with founder-level hunger, and real enthusiasm for voice and audio technology - you have opinions on it, not just interest

 What makes a strong candidate: 
 Experience in the AI industry, especially in AI Strategy and Operations or Product Operations roles

 A track record of going out of your way to get things done proactively

 More Details

However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success.  Enable the platform to power all Matrix42 product lines with a coherent, opinionated experience

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Tandem Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem. 

 We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures. 

 We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members.  

 Your role will be to: Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests. 

 Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas. 

 Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket. 

 Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on. 

 

 You are the right fit for the role if you: Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale. 

 Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics. 

 Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped. 

 Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English. 

 Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there. 

 Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved. 

 Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations. 

 

 The benefits 
Passion for languages:  
 We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us. 

 Take a deep dive:  
 As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style. 

 Teams who train together, stay together:  
 We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead. 

 It takes a team to Tandem:  
 Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights. 

 Balance matters:  
 Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax. 

 Modern family:  
 As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem. 

 Relocation without the stress:  
 If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time. 

 Hybrid by design:  
 We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management
jobs.description:
Why Verifone

For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. 

About The Role

We are seeking a visionary and results-oriented Senior Product Leader to lead Verifone's product strategy and execution across key business lines. This role will oversee the full product lifecycle, from ideation and market analysis to launch and ongoing optimization. The Senior Director will partner closely with engineering, sales, marketing, and operations to deliver innovative solutions that meet customer needs and drive business growth. 

This is a high-impact leadership role requiring deep product expertise, strategic thinking, and the ability to inspire cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, global environment. The ideal candidate brings broad knowledge across the complete payments solution stack and a proven track record of delivering complex, enterprise-scale initiatives across EMEA markets. 

Key Responsibilities 

Product Strategy & Leadership 

  • Develop and execute product strategy aligned with Verifone's vision and business objectives. 
  • Lead portfolio management across multiple product lines, ensuring market relevance and profitability. 
  • Define product roadmaps and prioritize initiatives based on customer needs, market trends, and business goals. 
  • Apply deep knowledge across the complete solution stack — including hardware/payment devices, payment applications, gateways, acquiring processing, and acquiring services — to inform strategic product direction. 

Market & Customer Focus 

  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and threats across EMEA and global markets. 
  • Champion the voice of the customer by integrating feedback into product development.

 Must-Haves

 Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau in Wort und Schrift, mit der Gabe, Komplexes einfach zu machen – „erklär's mir wie einem 5-Jährigen“ ist für dich ein Kompliment.

 Bachelor/Master in Marketing, Life Sciences, Healthcare Management o. Ä.

 Grundverständnis von DSGVO und Datenschutz im Gesundheitswesen.

 Sicheres Arbeiten in schnelllebigen Multi-Stakeholder-Umgebungen.

Hier erwarten dich viele Projekte, bei denen du deine kreativen Fähigkeiten einsetzen kannst!

About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.

About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.


About the Product Team 

At Emplifi, our mission is to transform how digital marketing—especially on social—is done, and how consumers connect with brands in the 21st century.

Our Product team sits at the heart of this mission. We build and evolve a data-driven SaaS platform that helps global enterprises market smarter. By bridging customer needs, business goals, and technical innovation, we break down silos, foster collaboration, and use insights to guide smart, impactful decisions.


About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced, data-driven Senior Product Manager to shape the future of Emplifi’s Data Insights capabilities — a core product area that enables brands to understand conversations, uncover emerging topics, and act on market signals that matter most.

This is about building intelligence that helps brands understand what people care about, how perceptions evolve, and where opportunities arise across digital channels. You’ll be leading a product area that helps marketers and strategists collect the right data and turn them into actionable insight—at scale.

You’ll own the roadmap, vision, and execution for this strategic capability, partnering closely with design, engineering, data science, and go-to-market teams to create powerful, intuitive experiences for enterprise users. This includes managing integrations with external data providers to ensure scalable, high-quality access to insights.

This position is remote/hybrid from within the Czech Republic, the UK, France, or Germany. 



Why This Role Matters

In today’s world, tracking discourse, sentiment, and context across digital sources gives brands a competitive edge. Organizations that move fast to uncover trends, surface risks, and respond to emergent feedback win. You’ll lead a product at the intersection of data, AI, and strategy helping the world’s leading brands stay in tune with conversations, perceptions, and signals that shape their markets.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about turning complex, unstructured data into clear insight and action
  • Understands how enterprise marketers, analysts, and strategists use insights to guide decisions
  • Can translate business challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions powered by AI and analytics
  • Thrives in a space where technology, storytelling, and customer empathy meet

What You’ll Do Here

  • Own the vision and roadmap for one of the Data Insights product line — setting direction based on customer needs, market dynamics, and company goals
  • Drive product discovery - talking to customers (brands and retailers), observing behavior, synthesizing data, and identifying unmet needs and opportunities
  • Translate ideas into execution - write clear requirements, work with design and engineering, and iterate fast to deliver impactful, high-quality solutions
  • Be a market expert - understand the competitive landscape and adjacent categories, monitor trends in ecommerce and AI, and translate them into product strategy
  • Manage data partnerships and integrations - oversee connections with third-party data providers and APIs, ensuring consistent, reliable data access, evaluate vendor performance, react quickly to API or data schema changes, and balance product impact against integration costs
  • Partner cross-functionally - collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Leadership to position the product for success across the customer lifecycle

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager- Time to First Production
jobs.description:
Register Here! 
 
 Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

 Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 
 
 About the role: 
 From the moment a team opens Camunda for the first time, our job is to help them succeed — fast. As Principal Product Manager for Time to First Production, you'll own exactly that experience: the journey from a new team's very first workspace (or first local start) to their first process running confidently in production. Your mission is simple to say and genuinely exciting to build: make that first win happen sooner, more smoothly, and more reliably than ever before.
 You'll be the DRI for one of Product Strategy's three company-wide outcome areas, with real license to shape it — define what a great first experience looks like, build the measurement that proves we're delivering it, and set the strategy and priorities that Engineering, Design, and our Experience org build against. It's a founding-type mandate: the outcome area is established and the ambition is clear, and you'll have the room to define the metric, the roadmap, and the experience that gets us there.
 You'll work at the intersection of Camunda's push into agentic, AI-first ways of building (AI-assisted modeling, agentic development, ProcessOS-style process re-engineering) and the fundamentals of a great first-run experience (onboarding, guided building, testing, and the path to production). It's a role for someone who loves turning a bold, company-wide ambition — delight customers from day one — into a measurable, funded, and genuinely exciting product
 Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale 
 
 What You Will Do: 
 Own the Time to First Production outcome area end to end: define its north-star metric(s), the customer journey they represent, and the roadmap of investments ("rocks" and initiatives) that move them.

 Partner with the Validation team to build best-in-class, end-to-end measurement of the journey, so we always know exactly how well we're delivering for new teams and where to invest next.

 Set direction and make prioritization calls across a portfolio of initiatives spanning AI-assisted and agentic building experiences, guided onboarding, testing/validation tooling, the path to production, and human-in-the-loop process experiences — in close partnership with Engineering, Design, and Experience pod leads.

 Represent this outcome area to SLT, Product Marketing, and GTM, translating fast-moving product work into a clear, evidence-based narrative for internal and external audiences.

 Collaborate closely with fellow Outcome DRIs (Enterprise Adoption, Production Confidence) to keep the three outcome areas coherent as one product strategy, and to hand work cleanly across the outcome boundaries (e.g., "first process" vs. "the second process and beyond").

 Bring an outside-in, evidence-based lens — grounding roadmap decisions in real customer needs and feedback, not internal assumptions.

 
 What You Bring: 
 Significant experience as a Principal/Staff-level Product Manager owning a cross-cutting, metrics-driven outcome or platform area (not a single feature surface) in B2B or enterprise SaaS.

 A track record of building measurement and north-star metrics from scratch — comfortable partnering with data/analytics functions to go from "we don't really know" to a credible, trusted number.

 Strong influence and cross-functional leadership skills: you can align Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive stakeholders around a strategy without relying on formal authority.

 Excellent written communication — this role's primary tool is the strategy document that others build against, so clear, structured writing matters as much as decision-making.

jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser, and Pocket, a service for keeping up with the best content online. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

We’re looking for a hands-on Mobile Product Manager with a primary focus on Firefox for iOS, while also contributing across mobile (including Android).

This role is about building a better browser, turning downloads into loyal users, and creating experiences that truly stand out. If you’ve shipped mobile apps, obsess over details that improve everyday use, and love turning user insights into real improvements, this is a great opportunity to drive impact at Firefox.

What you’ll do:

  • Drive strong activation and retention: focus on the new-user journey, quickly hooking people after they install the app, understanding where they drop off, and relentlessly optimizing the funnel through data, testing and iteration.
  • Deliver differentiating features and experiences that make Firefox stickier for key user groups, the kinds of things others can’t or won’t build.
  • Work closely with engineers, designers, data science and TPMs to ship high-impact improvements while balancing user needs, technical constraints, privacy and performance goals.
  • Stay deeply connected to real users: track App Store trends and discussions, test apps hands-on, analyze reviews and analytics, and turn those insights into concrete enhancements for Firefox on iOS and Android.
  • Monitor app health in App Store Connect and Google Play Console (crashes, ANRs, ratings) and support acquisition/retention efforts through ASO, store listings and growth experiments.
  • Adapt and optimize Firefox for global markets (Europe, Japan, Asia etc.), keeping cultural differences and local realities like data constraints in mind.

What you'll bring:

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung Du bist die Brücke zwischen unserer Produktentwicklung und einem der stärksten Performance-Marketing-Teams im europäischen D2C: Jeder Schuh verlässt bei dir die Entwicklung mit fertiger Launch-Story, belegten Aussagen und Creative-Angles. Und du baust den Insight-Motor auf, der aus Millionen Ad-Kommentaren und einem eigenen Kunden-Panel die Produkt-Briefs von morgen macht. Bei Pammys ist Product Marketing keine Übersetzungs-Abteilung — es sitzt im Produktbereich und entscheidet, welches Produkt für welche Nische gebaut wird. 

 Deine Aufgaben Du planst und steuerst unsere Produktlaunches: Timing, Positionierung, Abstimmung mit Performance, Creator-Team, CRM und Shop
 Du baust unsere Insights-Funktion auf: ein eigenes Kunden-Panel, Segmentierung, qualitative Interviews — und die systematische Auswertung von Community- und Anzeigen-Feedback
 Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Produkt-Briefs: Passform- und Komfort-Themen, Wünsche, nächste Modell-Ideen — direkt in die Produktentwicklung und zum Founder
 Du lieferst Botschaft und Angle-Hypothesen an das Creative-Team — Testergebnisse aus den Kampagnen fließen zurück in deinen Insight-Kreislauf
 Du entwickelst pro Produkt die Kernbotschaft: welches Problem es löst, für wen, warum jetzt – und briefst damit Creative-Team und Creator
 Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  
 Du wertest Kundenfeedback systematisch aus (Surveys, Reviews, Retourengründe) und bringst die Erkenntnisse ins Produktteam und in die Kampagnen
 Du konzipierst Angebote und Bundles mit und rechnest sie durch – auf Deckungsbeitrag, nicht nur auf Conversion
 Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  
 

 Dein Profil 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in Product Marketing, Brand Management oder Growth – idealerweise bei einer D2C-Brand oder im E-Commerce
 Du hast schon Produktlaunches verantwortet und kannst konkret sagen, was dabei rausgekommen ist
 Du schreibst selbst: Positionierungen, Briefings, Landingpage-Copy. Klar und ohne Floskeln
 Du arbeitest mit Zahlen: Conversion, Deckungsbeitrag, Sell-Through sagen dir etwas
 Du verstehst, wie Performance-Creative funktioniert und was ein Hook ist 
 Sehr gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch
 

 Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Maximaler Einfluss: Product Marketing sitzt bei uns direkt an der Schnittstelle von Produkt, Growth und Founder-Team. Deine Erkenntnisse beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche Produkte wir als Nächstes entwickeln.
 Keine Marketing-Theorie: Du arbeitest mit echten Kunden, echten Kaufdaten und sehr großen Mengen an Performance- und Creative-Daten und siehst unmittelbar, welche Entscheidungen funktionieren.
 Extrem schnelle Feedback-Loops: Produkt, Performance Marketing, Creative, CRM und E-Commerce arbeiten eng zusammen. Was du entwickelst, landet nicht Monate später in einer Präsentation, sondern wird getestet.
 Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du übernimmst keine fertige Product-Marketing-Struktur, sondern kannst Prozesse, Customer-Insights-Systeme und Launch-Mechaniken selbst aufbauen und prägen.
 Große Reichweite: Deine Arbeit beeinflusst Produkte und Kampagnen für eine Brand mit bereits über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden.
 Direkter Austausch mit den Foundern: Kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Geschwindigkeit und direkter Zugang zu den Personen, die Produkt- und Unternehmensstrategie verantworten.
 Starkes Performance-Marketing-Umfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit einem datengetriebenen Performance- und Creative-Team zusammen und kannst Produktmarketing unmittelbar mit realem Marktfeedback verbinden.
 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir wollen nicht, dass du bestehende Prozesse nur ausführst. Wir erwarten, dass du sie hinterfragst und besser machst.
 Steile Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Pammys wächst weiter in neue Produkte, Kategorien und Märkte. Dein Verantwortungsbereich kann mit diesem Wachstum deutlich größer werden.
 Unternehmerische Kultur: Wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Entscheidungen treffen und Ergebnisse liefern wollen.

jobs.title: Head of Product Development & Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung Wir machen wenige Modelle in großen Stückzahlen — jeder Millimeter am Leisten, im Fußbett und in der Konstruktion multipliziert sich hunderttausendfach. Aus diesem Grund muss der Schuh perfekt sitzen. Du baust Produkte nach der Pammys Bibel. Bisher entwickeln wir eng mit Partnern. Jetzt bauen wir die technische Produktentwicklung im eigenen Haus auf: eigene Leisten- und Passform-Standards, eigene Komfort-Technologien, ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam. 

 Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest den kompletten Entwicklungsprozess: Brief → Tech-Pack → Proto-Runden → Sales Samples → Sealed Sample → Serienanlauf (Tooling-Trials, PPS, TOP). Jedes technische Gate auf diesem Weg liegt bei dir — inklusive der Freigabe, mit der ein Modell in Serie geht.
 Du baust dein Team auf und führst es: Footwear Development, Leisten & Passform (Last & Fit), Tooling, Commercialisation und Materials — in der Reihenfolge, die das Wachstum verlangt.
 Du etablierst Leisten und Passform als Kernkompetenz: eigene Leisten-Bibliothek, Passform-Standards, Grading — bei Comfort-Schuhen ist der Leisten das Produkt.
 Du entwickelst unsere eigenen Komfort-Technologien für Fußbett und Sohle — gemeinsam mit starken Material- und Compound-Partnern.
 Du verankerst Wear-Tests sowie Prüf- und Compliance-Standards (SATRA/ISO, REACH, Produktsicherheit für den EU-Markt) im Entwicklungsprozess.
 Du arbeitest im festen Dreier-Team mit Produktmanagement und Design: Du machst Entwürfe baubar, ohne sie kleinzumachen.
 Du stimmst dich eng mit unserem Sourcing ab — zu Machbarkeit, Werkzeugen und Serienanlauf.
 

 Dein Profil Langjährige Erfahrung in der Footwear-Produktentwicklung (typischerweise 10+ Jahre), davon mehrere Jahre fabrikseitig in Asien — im Sample Room, nicht nur im Videocall.
 Ideal: Erfahrung mit Comfort-Produkten oder EVA (Spritzguss, Formteile) — alternativ Athletic Footwear mit echter Tooling-Tiefe.
 Führungserfahrung: Du hast Entwicklungsteams geführt und einen T&A-Kalender über mehrere Modelle parallel gehalten.
 Solides Handwerk in FOB-Kalkulation, Tooling-Ökonomie und Materialkunde.
 Verhandlungssicheres Englisch und Reisebereitschaft.
 

 Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Du baust die technische Produktentwicklung von Grund auf auf: Statt bestehende Strukturen nur zu verwalten, definierst du unsere Standards für Leisten, Passform, Komfort, Tooling und Commercialisation selbst.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Search
jobs.description:
About Wolt 

 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

 We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find.

 The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

 Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app.

 What you'll work on

 
 Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain 

 Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision.

 Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market.

 
 Our humble expectations

 We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them.

 
 You bring proven experience as a Product Manager in Consumer, or on another relevance- or ranking-driven consumer experience.

 You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it.

 You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight.

 You work backwards from the customer problem, and you can weigh that against the most urgent business problems at the same time, rather than treating it as a side you have to pick.

 You think strategically: you can zoom out to where the domain should be in two years, then zoom back in on what we should ship next quarter.

 You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible. This industry is changing fast, AI most of all, and the plan we write in January won't be the plan in June.

 You work deeply with ML and engineering on relevance and ranking, without needing to be an ML expert yourself.

 You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and you can tell real value from hype.

 You build a case and bring people with you: engineering, design, analytics, and local market teams across three brands and many markets.

 You do your best work with range: global platform thinking one week, a specific market's reality the next.

 
 Next steps

 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

 
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments. 
 We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today. 

 About the team At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution. 

 Your mission You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities. 

 Responsibilities Translate Needs:  Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team. 

 Push the Backlog:  Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones.

 Document Capabilities:  Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver. 

 Evaluate & Accept Work:  Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines. 

 

 Qualifications Experience:  3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms. 

 Technical Literacy:  You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers. 

 Systems Thinking:  A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Too Good To Go, we dream of a planet with no food waste.

Did you know that more than 40% of all food produced gets thrown away? This unnecessary food waste — and the resources needed to produce and transport it — accounts for 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions.

Too Good To Go is a certified B Corporation on a mission to end food waste. We connect stores with surplus food to consumers across 20 markets in Europe, North America, and APAC — with over 140 million registered users, more than 200,000 daily active stores, and 600 million meals saved from going to waste.

Why This Role

Pricing sits at the centre of everything we do. It shapes what partners earn, what consumers pay, and how much surplus food actually gets saved. Today, pricing decisions are made in different places, for different reasons, without a single team owning the strategy end to end.

We are changing that. We are building our first dedicated Pricing team — and you will be the founding member.

You will start with a concrete, high-value problem: the pricing infrastructure behind our Key Account deals. That's your launchpad — from there, you will have real scope to shape our approach to dynamic pricing, consumer-facing service fees, and pricing strategy across Too Good To Go more broadly. This is a role built for someone who wants to define a domain, not just execute a brief.

The goal behind everything we do is twofold: save as much surplus food as possible, and grow the pie between TGTG, our Partners, and our Consumers — never trading one off against the other.

There is a further dimension to this. We are expanding beyond food into new non-food, non-perishable categories — and that growth brings pricing complexity and opportunity we have not had to solve before. Getting ahead of that, rather than reacting to it, is part of this role.

Your Mission

As Senior Product Manager for Pricing, you will build the foundation for how Too Good To Go prices its marketplace — starting with Key Account deals, then extending across the business.

In the near term, you will design and ship the infrastructure that lets us set, manage, and evolve pricing for Key Account partnerships with the flexibility our commercial teams need. From there, you will develop a smarter, more dynamic pricing algorithm that responds to supply, demand, and partner economics — replacing static rules with something genuinely intelligent. Alongside this, you will investigate our consumer-facing service fees: how they're structured, how they're perceived, and where there is room to optimise.

Underneath all of it are two questions you will own: how do we price in a way that saves as much surplus food as possible, and how do we grow the pie for everyone — Too Good To Go, our Partners, and our Consumers — rather than shifting value from one side to another? Answering both well means understanding marketplace pricing broadly: the best practices and patterns other two- and three-sided marketplaces use, and what applies to ours.

Pricing decisions rarely stay inside one product's boundaries, so you will work across product teams and the wider organisation — Commercial, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and Key Accounts — to make sure pricing is right everywhere it shows up, not just within your own roadmap. You will become the go-to person for anything pricing-related at Too Good To Go, including presenting your strategy and results to the Global Management Team.

You will also help lay the pricing groundwork for our move into non-food, non-perishable categories — different cost structures, margins, and purchase patterns than the food pricing we know today, and a chance to shape pricing thinking for a new part of the business from the start.

The Team

You will be the founding Pricing PM, operating as an individual contributor, with a small dedicated engineering team of around 3-4 developers to start. We will grow the team's scope and headcount as we prove impact, not before. You will report directly to our VP of Product.

This is a new team with a clear starting point, not a fixed script. You will know where to begin — Key Account deals — but how the team's remit, roadmap, and impact grow from there is largely yours to shape. If you want a role where everything is already solved and you are just executing, this isn't it. If you want to help define what great pricing looks like across Too Good To Go, it is.

The role is suited to someone who does not need daily direction — who can set the agenda within that mandate, manage up effectively, and make strong pricing calls with incomplete information.
