About us Since 2000,  ITA Logistics Group  has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms  LetMeShip  and  ParcelParcel , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service. 
 Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us. 

 Your mission As our  (Technical) Product Owner (m/f/d) , you will be part of our Product Team and take ownership of key technical interfaces and integrations across our platforms. Your main focus will be on our  Customer APIs , the  Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) , and, going forward, the  Unified Financial Platform (UFP)  as well as our  HubSpot integration . 
 You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving. 
 You will collaborate closely with our Product Owners, Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers, and Data Insights team while also acting as an important point of contact for internal stakeholders, customers, carriers, and external partners. 

 Your Key Responsibilities You own and continuously develop the  roadmap for our Customer APIs  across LMS Enterprise and LMS Next. 

 You drive the  migration of our API customers from LMS Enterprise to LMS Next , identifying and prioritizing the features and carrier integrations required to make the transition successful. 

 You act as a technical point of contact for our API customers, supporting them with questions, troubleshooting, and technical challenges. 

 You take ownership of the development of our  Unified Carrier Interface (UCI)  in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. 

 You analyze requirements for carrier features and services, translate them into clear requirements for Engineering, and support QA in defining relevant test cases. 

 You communicate directly with our carriers to clarify technical requirements and integration specifics. 

 Once live, you take ownership of our  Unified Financial Platform (UFP)  and manage its backlog, requirements, and further development. 

 You continuously monitor our existing  HubSpot integration  and prioritize adjustments based on evolving business needs and feedback. 

 Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. 

 

 What you need to succeed You have a  technical background , for example in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or several years of experience working at the intersection of Product and Engineering. 

 You have experience as a  Product Owner or Product Manager , ideally working with APIs, platforms, or technical integrations. 

 You have a solid understanding of  APIs, API design, versioning, and migration strategies  and feel confident engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineers. 

 You are able to understand complex technical topics and translate them clearly for different audiences. 

 You are confident in  stakeholder management  and know how to balance and prioritize competing technical and business needs. 

 You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and adapting to changing priorities while keeping a clear overview of what matters most. 

 You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and locations, including with colleagues in  Hamburg and Naarden . 

 You are curious about  AI tools and digital solutions  and enjoy exploring new ways to improve productivity, processes, and workflows. 

 Experience in  logistics, parcel, or freight tech , particularly with carrier API integrations, is a plus. 

 Familiarity with  HubSpot or CRM integrations , as well as financial or invoicing systems and interfaces, is also a plus. 

 

 Why ITA Logistics Group? You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE This is your opportunity to own a real product at a company building something genuinely new. As our Senior Product Manager, you join a small, senior product team at a stage where one person's judgment visibly shapes the product.

You will own product topics end to end: understanding the customer, deciding what is worth building and why, shaping the concept, and seeing it through to a shipped result that delivers value. You do this for your own set of topics, alongside our Director Product Management and our CPO, who both work hands-on. You start by owning the flow of customer requests and insights, the fastest way to learn our product and our customers, and grow over the first 6 to 12 months into owning whole product areas with the same autonomy. You develop the product; our
engineers build it.

We are building a product in a new category, so there is no playbook to copy. The work is genuinely conceptual: understand how digital B2B products work, understand our users' problems, and invent viable solutions. Our engineering team works closely and continuously with product, no throwing specs over a wall, and most of that collaboration happens remotely.

If you want real ownership, the influence to shape a product from an early stage, and the discipline of a spec-driven, high-bar team, this is the right moment to join.

 What will be your responsibility Own a set of product topics end to end, from the customer problem through to a shipped result that delivers real value
 Decide what is worth building and in what order for your topics, shape the concept, and drive it through delivery together with engineering
 Run discovery with customers to understand what they actually need, test your assumptions rather than building on guesses, and turn what you learn into clear product decisions
 Own the flow of customer requests and insights: make sense of what customers are asking for, decide what it means for the product, route it to the right place, and turn a stream of raw input into clear product direction
 Translate real problems into clear, well-scoped, buildable definitions, working spec-driven (currently with OpenSpec) at a high bar
 Invent viable product concepts in a category with no existing product to copy
 Shape the UX and UI together with engineering, based on the existing product and the component library - we have no dedicated designer in the team
 Work hand in hand with our remote engineering team throughout the build rather than through handover: analyse a solution for gaps and edge cases before it is built, using AI where it helps, and after shipping, check whether the outcome delivered its intended value and works for users
 

 What you'll need A track record of owning B2B SaaS products end to end, from customer problem to shipped outcome, with real accountability for whether they delivered value
 A genuine understanding of how digital B2B products work, and the ability to invent viable concepts rather than copy existing patterns
 Strong requirements and scoping judgment: you make vague problems complete, unambiguous and correctly scoped, and you know what to leave out
 A structured, process-driven way of working, paired with genuine comfort in a fast, unstructured startup environment
 Fluent, daily use of AI tools (Claude or equivalent) as a normal part of how you think, write specs and
analyse problems, since we're an AI-first team and expect the same of you.
 Experience working in a spec-driven environment (OpenSpec or similar); turning fuzzy intent into rigorous, complete, buildable definition is second nature to you
 Data-model fluency: you reason comfortably about entities and how they relate, enough to break problems down and hold a real bar with engineering
 Technical fluency: not afraid of a terminal, and able to reason about data flows, system constraints, and how an agentic product behaves
 Proven experience collaborating closely with a remote engineering team
 Fluent in English; professional German is a strong plus given our customers
 

 What we'll offer you Remote-first setup, Europe-based so we stay reasonably timezone-aligned, with access to our Munich office and backyard workspace
 Flexible working hours and a "take what you need" vacation policy
 Direct collaboration with our Director Product Management and CPO, and real ownership of your own product areas
 Competitive salary plus virtual ESOP, so you grow with us
 A team of motivated, kind, and inspiring colleagues
 A role in a growing SaaS company in the Data & AI space, joining at the ideal moment to make a lasting impact
 Regular team events and some friendly Spikeball or Table Tennis matches
 

 Extra props for Experience in the Data, Analytics, or AI space
 Experience with AI or agentic products
 Experience building in a new or emerging product category
 Experience working in a remote-first team
 Curiosity for technology and innovation
 Strong Spikeball or Table Tennis skills (our signature Mindfuel games)
 

 Fin
